commands_run:
# 1. Run master sequence evaluations across T1, T2, T3 (clean and degraded)
& .venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts/xvs/horizon_att/run_evaluation.py --data-root="<repo>\output" --workers 8

# 2. Run unit and verification test suite
& .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pytest tests/xvs/test_horizon_att_*.py -v -k "not data"

# 3. Generate Charter §8 report and formatted tables
& .venv\Scripts\python.exe scripts/xvs/horizon_att/report_tables_wp06.py --data-root="<repo>\output"
